items.title: A substrate-first-enzymology deep-learning framework for transforming new-to-nature chemicals
items.abstract_or_text: Enzyme activity data favor familiar substrates and positive outcomes, creating survivorship bias that limits predictions for new-to-nature chemistry. Here we introduce substrate-first enzymology: a chemically diverse substrate array is designed to broaden coverage of a predefined, synthetically relevant chemical space, independently of expected activity. Alcohol dehydrogenases (ADHs) are systematically assayed against this array using a unified high-throughput assay. The enzyme–substrate matrix records activity labels and turnover frequency ( k cat ) values; substrate-resolved profiles form an ADH k cat atlas. A deep learning model trained on these data classifies activity and predicts k cat for active pairs. The model outperforms existing approaches under matched training and evaluation conditions and prospectively prioritizes active substrates from underrepresented chemical space. Without binding-pocket annotations, the model’s attention mechanism highlights substrate reactive centers and catalytically relevant residues. By designing substrate coverage before measurement and retaining both positive and negative outcomes, this framework reduces historical sampling bias and supports interpretable k cat prediction beyond historically sampled chemistry.
items.summary_zh: 作者提出 substrate-first enzymology：先设计覆盖化学空间的多样底物阵列，再用统一高通量实验系统测量 alcohol dehydrogenases（ADHs）的活性和 k cat，构建 ADH k cat atlas，并训练深度学习模型预测活性和 k cat。模型在匹配条件下优于既有方法，并前瞻性地优先筛选出代表性不足化学空间中的活性底物。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究针对酶活性数据偏向熟悉底物和阳性结果造成的 survivorship bias，提出了数据采集先于模型的设计原则，并保留阴性结果。其验证聚焦 ADHs 和预定义化学空间，能否迁移到其他酶家族、反应类型及更复杂底物仍需检验。
items.abstract_zh: 酶活性数据偏向熟悉的底物和阳性结果，由此产生的 survivorship bias 限制了对 new-to-nature chemistry 的预测。在此，我们提出 substrate-first enzymology：设计一个化学多样的底物阵列，以拓宽对预先定义、具有合成相关性的化学空间的覆盖，并使其独立于预期活性。我们使用统一的高通量测定，对 alcohol dehydrogenases（ADHs）系统性地测试该底物阵列。酶–底物矩阵记录活性标签和周转频率（ k cat ）值；按底物解析的特征形成 ADH k cat atlas。在这些数据上训练的深度学习模型对活性进行分类，并预测活性配对的 k cat。与既有方法相比，该模型在匹配的训练和评估条件下表现更好，并以前瞻方式从代表性不足的化学空间中优先筛选活性底物。在不使用结合口袋注释的情况下，模型的注意力机制突出了底物反应中心和催化相关残基。通过在测量前设计底物覆盖范围，并保留阳性和阴性结果，该框架减少了历史采样偏差，并支持对历史采样化学空间之外的 k cat 进行可解释预测。

items.abstract_or_text: The loudest voices stoking fears about AI dangers have made tremendous headway in the past two weeks. AI technology has not taken some unexpected, dangerous turn, but the hype around it — propelled by what appears to be a well orchestrated PR campaign — has drummed up considerable fear. I worry that it represents a setback for our field. I have written frequently that fears of AI are overhyped. AI’s capabilities can be uncannily human-like and unpredictable, and it’s rational to worry when people who are directly involved express concerns. But I see the problems as a sign of the engineering work that ahead, rather than insurmountable barriers or the sky falling. AI technology continues to advance — which is a good thing! — but technical advances, poorly understood by the public, give those who seek to generate hype repeated opportunities to do so. First, I don’t see any step up in the risk of human extinction from AI compared to a few months ago. The theories about this remain the same fantastical, science fiction scenarios as a few months ago. The biggest change in AI risk is its cybersecurity capabilities — a topic which we should take seriously — but this, too, will not lead to the end of the world. The most notable recent event leading to increased fear was when an OpenAI team deployed an agent swarm that hacked into Hugging Face. Much of the popular press contained significant hype. For example, some publications reported that a swarm of 1,200 agents carried out the attack. While this was technically accurate, as I write this, I have about 1,300 processes running on my laptop. Yes, the ability to get large swarms of agents to work in parallel on a task is a significant technical advance. And, in computing, many processes run at the same time. So this shouldn’t be seen as some magical capability. Additionally, OpenAI’s buggy sandboxing and monitoring processes were key to enabling this incident. Fixing these bugs and putting in place improved monitoring would be appropriate fixes, not pausing AI. There are many well known ways to attack software systems. The main advantage of AI agents is that they are relentless. They will tirelessly try many tactics — and have the patience to chain vulnerabilities together — that previously would have taken an infeasible amount of human effort. But in the long term, I believe the advantage will lie with defenders (because they have more information with which to identify bugs, which they can fix), but the cyber-threat landscape has changed significantly. Pausing AI progress will create much more harm than benefit. First, our adversaries will certainly not slow down. Second, engineering requires discovering problems empirically so we can fix them. If we pause AI by a decade, we will also delay finding and implementing safety engineering fixes by about the same duration. Taking a hard technical look at the actual risks however, I see little factual basis for the degree of fear that’s been stoked up. We still have hard research and engineering work ahead to improve AI safety, but the beneficial applications continue to vastly outweigh the risks, and we should keep building.
items.summary_zh: Andrew Ng 认为，近期 AI 风险讨论中的恐惧被炒作放大；他将智能体带来的主要新风险归为网络安全能力，并主张通过修复沙箱、监控和其他安全工程问题来降低风险，而不是暂停 AI 进展。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 作者观点具体涉及智能体网络攻击、并行进程与安全工程责任，能够推动对“暂停发展”与“经验性修复”两种路径的专业讨论。帖文中的事件归因和风险判断属于作者论述，并非本候选集独立核验的结论。
items.abstract_zh: 过去两周，最声嘶力竭地煽动对人工智能危险担忧的人取得了巨大进展。人工智能技术并没有发生某种出乎意料的危险转向，但围绕它的炒作——似乎由一场精心组织的公关活动推动——已经制造了相当大的恐惧。我担心这会给我们的领域带来挫折。我经常写道，对人工智能的恐惧被夸大了。人工智能的能力可能令人难以置信地类似人类且不可预测；当直接参与其中的人表达担忧时，担心是理性的。但我认为这些问题说明我们还有工程工作要做，而不是不可逾越的障碍，或世界末日正在降临。人工智能技术仍在进步——这是好事！——但公众并不充分理解的技术进展，给那些寻求制造炒作的人提供了反复利用的机会。首先，与几个月前相比，我看不到人工智能导致人类灭绝的风险有所上升。这些理论仍然是同样玄幻、科幻式的情景。人工智能风险中最大的近期变化是它的网络安全能力——这是一个我们应该认真对待的议题——但这同样不会导致世界末日。最近导致恐惧增加的最显著事件，是 OpenAI 团队部署了一个入侵 Hugging Face 的智能体群。大众媒体的大量报道包含了明显炒作。例如，一些出版物报道说有 1200 个智能体实施了这次攻击。虽然这在技术上是准确的，但在我写这段话时，我的笔记本上大约运行着 1300 个进程。是的，让大规模智能体并行协作完成任务是一项重要技术进步。而在计算机中，许多进程本来就会同时运行。因此，不应把它看成某种神奇能力。此外，OpenAI 有缺陷的沙箱和监控流程是促成这起事件的关键。修复这些漏洞并建立改进的监控机制才是适当的修复措施，而不是暂停 AI。攻击软件系统有许多众所周知的方法。AI 智能体的主要优势在于它们不知疲倦。它们会不间断地尝试许多策略，并有耐心把漏洞串联起来——过去这需要人类付出不可行的巨大努力。但从长期看，我相信优势会在防守方一边（因为他们拥有更多用于识别漏洞的信息，并且可以修复漏洞），但网络威胁格局已经发生了显著变化。暂停 AI 进展带来的危害会远大于收益。第一，我们的对手当然不会放慢脚步。第二，工程工作需要通过经验发现问题，以便修复。如果我们让 AI 暂停十年，发现并实施安全工程修复措施也会推迟大约同样长的时间。然而，仔细从技术层面审视实际风险，我看不到足以支撑当前恐惧程度的事实依据。我们仍有艰巨的研究和工程工作要做，以改进 AI 安全，但有益应用仍然远远超过风险，我们应该继续建设。

items.abstract_or_text: Beautiful paper from Google. ScientistTwo shows another progress of recursive self-improvement in AI research: it can improve a human method, then use its own discovery as the baseline and improve it again. Across problems based on ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS papers, it reports an 80.4% success rate and a 25.2% average relative improvement over the original human baselines.

items.abstract_or_text: Excited to share FloatLib, our verified arbitrary-precision floating-point arithmetic library in Lean. We’ve spent several months trying to bring together the best of both worlds: arithmetic we can prove correct and implementations that run efficiently. We built FloatLib to support verified machine learning and scientific computing, where rounding, overflow, and accumulation can change a program’s result. FloatLib supports IEEE binary and decimal, arbitrary-width posits, P3109, and small ML formats. You can also define your own formats and rounding rules. Each certified software backend comes with a Lean proof that it computes the specified result, including signed zeros and exceptional values. A lot of the work went into making those implementations faster, with lookup tables for tiny formats, machine-word kernels, and limb algorithms for wider arithmetic. They share the same specifications, so each optimization must come with a proof that it preserves the result. We also put FloatLib through extensive numerical checks and speed comparisons with established libraries, including MPFR, Flocq, FLoPS, Berkeley SoftFloat/TestFloat, and the posit libraries SoftPosit and Universal, across a range of formats, operations, and precisions. @Robertljg Project & Paper: https://t.co/OdTmKnT0Yy Code:

items.abstract_or_text: Test-time communication looks like a next axis for scaling capabilities New paper with the incredible @jon_ghoh and @vkontonis @ShivamGarg91462 and Akshay : https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.21032 The Hugging Face incident showed when agents can find a channel they'll use the heck out of it. A useful question, I think is: when does communication make a group MORE CAPABLE than the same agents working alone? Aka is Team-of-N better than Best-of-N, when, and why? We had N identical agents work on the same task with no prescribed roles, using only a shared log (i.e, text file) and telling them to "collaborate". Across three "researchy" tasks communicating teams beat the heck out of independent agents.

items.title: Large scale prospective evaluation of co-folding across hundreds of Mac1-ligand complexes and three virtual screens
items.abstract_or_text: Accurate prediction of ligand-bound protein complexes and ranking them by affinity are central problems in drug discovery. While deep learning co-folding methods can help address these challenges, their evaluation has been hampered by the difficulties in assessing independence from training data and insufficiently large test sets. Here we test the ability of co-folding methods to predict the structures of 551 ligands, 489 of which are of sufficient quality for evaluation, bound to the SARS-CoV-2 NSP3 macrodomain (Mac1) that were determined after the training cut-off dates. AlphaFold3 (AF3), Boltz-2, and Chai-1 each reproduced >50% of the Mac1 ligand poses to better than 2 [A] RMSD of experiment. Despite the potential for co-folding to describe protein conformational changes that stabilize ligand binding, we did not find that common conformational rearrangements, including peptide flip and a large loop opening, were recapitulated by the co-folding prediction. For AF3 and Chai-1, ligand pose prediction confidence weakly, but significantly, tracked experimental potency, while DOCK3.7 energies were only weakly correlated. Boltz-2 affinity predictions showed the strongest correlation with measured potency and, after calibration, achieved lower mean absolute error than a baseline predictor. We next assessed whether co-folding scores could rescore docking hit-lists to distinguish true ligands from non-binders among hundreds of molecules prospectively experimentally tested against AmpC {beta}-lactamase, the dopamine D4 and the {sigma}2 receptors. AF3 ligand pose confidence values did not separate true ligands from high-scoring false-positives as effectively as docking scores or Boltz-2 affinity predictions did. Taken together, the modest, but independent correlations of docking score and co-folding confidence or affinity suggests that integrating physics-based and deep-learning approaches may help with hit prioritization and subsequent optimization in structure-based ligand discovery.
items.summary_zh: 研究对 551 个 SARS-CoV-2 NSP3 macrodomain（Mac1）配体复合物开展独立于训练数据的大规模前瞻性共折叠评估，并进一步测试三个虚拟筛选场景。AlphaFold3、Boltz-2 和 Chai-1 均能对超过一半的配体重现优于 2 [A] RMSD 的实验构象；Boltz-2 的亲和力预测与实测效力相关性最强。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究提供了规模较大的、训练截止日期之后数据的共折叠评估，并把结构预测、亲和力排序和真实虚拟筛选命中区分开来。结果显示共折叠置信度不能稳定替代对接或亲和力模型，蛋白构象变化和高分假阳性仍是重要限制。
items.abstract_zh: 准确预测配体结合蛋白复合物并按亲和力对其排序，是药物发现中的核心问题。尽管深度学习共折叠方法有助于应对这些挑战，但由于难以评估其与训练数据的独立性以及缺少足够大规模的测试集，对它们的评估一直受到阻碍。在此，我们测试了共折叠方法预测 551 个配体结构的能力；其中 489 个配体具有足够质量，可用于评估。这些配体结合 SARS-CoV-2 NSP3 macrodomain（Mac1），其结构均在训练截止日期之后确定。AlphaFold3（AF3）、Boltz-2 和 Chai-1 都能将超过 50% 的 Mac1 配体构象重现到优于 2 [A] RMSD 的水平。尽管共折叠可能描述稳定配体结合的蛋白构象变化，我们没有发现常见的构象重排，包括肽翻转和大幅度环开放，能够在共折叠预测中得到重现。对于 AF3 和 Chai-1，配体构象预测置信度与实验效力呈弱但显著的关联，而 DOCK3.7 能量仅表现出弱相关性。Boltz-2 的亲和力预测与实测效力的相关性最强；校准后，其平均绝对误差低于基线预测器。随后，我们评估共折叠评分能否对接数百个分子的命中列表重新排序，从而在 AmpC {beta}-lactamase、dopamine D4 和 {sigma}2 receptors 的前瞻性实验测试中区分真实配体与非结合物。AF3 配体构象置信度区分真实配体和高评分假阳性的效果不如对接评分或 Boltz-2 亲和力预测。总的来说，对接评分与共折叠置信度或亲和力之间存在适度但相互独立的相关性，这表明整合基于物理的方法和深度学习方法，可能有助于在基于结构的配体发现中进行命中优先级排序和后续优化。

items.title: Large Language Models in Chemistry and Materials Science: A Comprehensive Survey
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) are expanding the scope of artificial intelligence in chemistry and materials science by connecting scientific knowledge, heterogeneous data, computational tools, and experimental workflows. This article presents a comprehensive survey of the foundations, representations, methods, applications, and evaluation of LLM-centered scientific systems. We develop a non-exclusive representation-by-mechanism taxonomy linking text, molecular and crystal structures, spectra, images, and numerical properties with model adaptation, cross-representation grounding, external knowledge and tools, and workflow coordination. Within this framework, we synthesize prompting, domain pre-training and fine-tuning, preference alignment and verifier-driven reinforcement learning, multimodal integration, and retrieval- and agent-based approaches. Applications span literature understanding, property prediction, molecular and materials design, synthesis planning, characterization, hypothesis generation, and closed-loop discovery. By linking method choices to input information, task definitions, and validation conditions, the framework clarifies which reported results can be compared and what scientific claims they support. We organize representative datasets and benchmarks and introduce an evaluation matrix connecting task performance with information fidelity, uncertainty, chemical and physical validity, and workflow reliability. Detailed supplementary cases document the settings and evidence underlying key comparisons. Finally, we identify research priorities in integrated scientific representations, efficient adaptation, reusable knowledge and tool interfaces, and verifiable human-machine collaboration. By linking methodological developments to scientific objectives, this survey provides a conceptual map and practical guidance for developing and assessing LLM-enabled chemical and materials discovery.
items.summary_zh: 这篇综述建立了面向化学和材料科学中 LLM 科学系统的表示–机制分类法，系统梳理提示、领域预训练与微调、偏好对齐、验证器驱动强化学习、多模态整合、检索和 agent 方法，并将任务性能与信息保真度、不确定性、化学与物理有效性及工作流可靠性联系起来。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 综述的价值在于把模型方法、输入信息、任务定义和验证条件放到同一比较框架中，有助于区分可比结果与过度外推的科学主张。其结论是框架性总结而非新的实验基准，具体方法和应用仍需回到原始研究核查。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）正通过连接科学知识、异质数据、计算工具和实验工作流，拓展人工智能在化学和材料科学中的应用范围。本文综述了以 LLM 为中心的科学系统的基础、表示、方法、应用和评估。我们建立了一种非互斥的“表示–机制”分类法，将文本、分子和晶体结构、光谱、图像及数值性质，与模型适配、跨表示 grounding、外部知识与工具以及工作流协调联系起来。在此框架下，我们综合讨论提示、领域预训练和微调、偏好对齐与验证器驱动的强化学习、多模态整合，以及基于检索和 agent 的方法。相关应用覆盖文献理解、性质预测、分子与材料设计、合成规划、表征、假设生成和闭环发现。通过将方法选择与输入信息、任务定义和验证条件联系起来，该框架阐明了哪些已报道结果可以相互比较，以及它们支持哪些科学主张。我们整理了具有代表性的数据集和基准，并提出一个评估矩阵，将任务性能与信息保真度、不确定性、化学和物理有效性以及工作流可靠性联系起来。详细的补充案例记录了关键比较所依据的设置和证据。最后，我们确定了综合科学表示、高效适配、可复用知识与工具接口以及可验证的人机协作等研究优先方向。通过将方法学发展与科学目标联系起来，本综述为开发和评估 LLM 驱动的化学与材料发现系统提供了概念地图和实践指导。

items.title: Quantifying Validation-Induced Optimism in Machine Learning for Food Spectroscopy: An Empirical Multi-Dataset Benchmark
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Evaluating machine-learning regression models in food spectroscopy using random row-wise cross-validation ignores hierarchical experimental structures (replicate scans, aliquot extractions, packaging batches, instruments, and harvest campaigns). While theoretical warnings caution against sample leakage, the chemometric literature lacks a multidataset empirical quantification of validation-induced optimism, its impact on model selection, and its underlying physical mechanisms. Methods: We executed an empirical multi-dataset benchmark across four benchmark food spectroscopy collections encompassing 12,706 source spectra/records, with 6,376 spectra evaluated in primary regression workflows: Cargill corn near-infrared (NIR; n = 240 spectra across 80 physical grain samples and 3 spectrometers; targets: moisture and protein), edible vegetable oils Raman (Gilbraith , 2024; n = 215 spectra across 52 distinct reference titration determinations; target: peroxide value), mango fruit dry matter NIR (Anderson , 2020; n = 4,233 calibration spectra across 5 cultivars and n = 1,448 external harvest season spectra; target: dry matter content), and Tecator meat NIR (n = 240 spectra with 24 duplicate pairs [48 rows participating in identical pairs], leaving 216 unique spectral profiles; targets: fat and moisture). Six regression algorithms—partial least squares (PLS), Ridge regression, support vector regression (SVR-RBF), Random Forest, XGBoost, and k-nearest neighbours (kNN, serving as a diagnostic sentinel)—were evaluated across four hierarchical validation tiers: Level 1 (random row-wise cross-validation), Level 2 (sample-aware group cross-validation, reference-valuegrouped validation, or deduplicated validation), Level 3 (cultivar-aware validation), and Level 4 (external instrument and seasonal holdout). Model specifications were held fixed across validation tiers to isolate validation design as the sole manipulated factor, and all spectral standardisation was strictly fitted within training partitions to eliminate unsupervised leakage. Results: Transitioning from random row-wise to structured validation systematically eroded apparent predictive performance across all 36 random-to-structured model–task contrasts, yielding a median validation-induced optimism ΔR2 of 0.0170 (mean 0.3290, interquartile range [0.0084, 0.3985]) and a median root-mean-square error inflation ratio (RR_RMSE = RMSE_structured / RMSE_random) of 1.1395 (mean 1.4277, IQR [1.0417, 1.4374], range [0.9406, 5.2645]). Degradation was especially pronounced under external domain transfer (median ΔR2 = 0.6399, median RR_RMSE = 1.8199). In edible oils containing replicate scans sharing identical titration reference values, random cross-validation produced catastrophic performance inflation for non-linear models: kNN collapsed from an apparent R2 of 0.8865 (RMSE 5.40 meq O2/kg) to −2.1443 (RMSE 28.43 meq O2/kg; RR_RMSE = 5.265), and Random Forest collapsed from R2 = 0.8437 to −0.5806 (RR_RMSE = 3.180). This replicate leakage completely inverted algorithm rankings (Spearman ρ = −0.886, p = 0.019; Kendall τ = −0.733, p = 0.056). Algorithm robustness under external transfer was domain-specific: Ridge was the most resilient model under Mango seasonal transfer (R2 = 0.6690, compared to R2 ≈ 0.13–0.17 for tree ensembles), whereas uncalibrated Corn instrument transfer caused severe degradation in linear models (Ridge R2 = −30.04, PLS R2 = −37.05) due to uncorrected spectrometer baseline shifts. In contrast, non-linear models exhibited smaller relative degradation under sensor transfer. Cross-partition nearest-neighbour spectral similarity dropped by up to 0.0164 under domain transfer. Across tasks, this similarity drop showed an exploratory positive association with kNN error inflation (Pearson r = 0.739, Spearman ρ = 0.912), consistent with a spectral-proximity mechanism whereby high optical similarity enables flexible models to interpolate training points rather than learning transferable chemical relationships. Conclusions: Random row-wise validation creates severe validation-induced optimism, distorts algorithm rankings, and rewards models that memorise experimental artefacts. Reporting standards, mandatory specimen-level split manifests, and the routine inclusion of kNN as a diagnostic canary are essential to restore methodological integrity and field deployability to machine learning in food analysis.
items.summary_zh: 研究在四个食品光谱数据集上比较随机逐行交叉验证与样本、参考值、品种、仪器和季节感知的结构化验证，评估 PLS、Ridge、SVR-RBF、Random Forest、XGBoost 和 kNN。结构化验证显著降低表观性能，并可导致算法排名反转，说明随机切分会奖励对实验伪影的记忆。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是一个具有方法警示意义的多数据集实证基准，直接量化了层级实验结构和数据泄漏造成的验证乐观偏差。研究对象是食品光谱回归，外推到其他化学信息学任务时仍需结合具体数据生成过程验证。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：在食品光谱学中评估机器学习回归模型时，随机逐行交叉验证忽略了层级实验结构（重复扫描、等分提取、包装批次、仪器和采收批次）。尽管理论警告指出了样本泄漏问题，化学计量学文献仍缺乏对验证诱导乐观偏差、其对模型选择的影响及其潜在物理机制的多数据集实证量化。方法：我们在四个食品光谱基准数据集上开展实证基准研究，共包含 12,706 条源光谱/记录，其中 6,376 条光谱进入主要回归流程评估：Cargill 玉米近红外（NIR；n = 240 条光谱，来自 80 个物理谷物样本和 3 台光谱仪；目标：水分和蛋白质）、食用植物油 Raman（Gilbraith，2024；n = 215 条光谱，来自 52 个不同的参考滴定测定；目标：过氧化值）、芒果干物质 NIR（Anderson，2020；n = 4,233 条校准光谱，覆盖 5 个品种，以及 n = 1,448 条外部采收季光谱；目标：干物质含量），以及 Tecator 肉类 NIR（n = 240 条光谱，其中有 24 对重复光谱，即 48 行参与相同配对，剩余 216 个独特光谱轮廓；目标：脂肪和水分）。六种回归算法——偏最小二乘（PLS）、Ridge regression、support vector regression（SVR-RBF）、Random Forest、XGBoost 和 k-nearest neighbours（kNN，作为诊断哨兵）——在四个层级验证层级中进行评估：Level 1（随机逐行交叉验证）、Level 2（样本感知的分组交叉验证、按参考值分组的验证或去重验证）、Level 3（品种感知验证）以及 Level 4（外部仪器和季节留出）。模型设定在各验证层级保持不变，以便将验证设计作为唯一操纵因素；所有光谱标准化都严格在训练分区内拟合，以消除无监督泄漏。结果：从随机逐行验证转换到结构化验证，在全部 36 个随机到结构化的模型–任务对比中，表观预测性能系统性下降，验证诱导的乐观偏差 ΔR2 的中位数为 0.0170（均值 0.3290，四分位距 [0.0084, 0.3985]），均方根误差膨胀比（RR_RMSE = RMSE_structured / RMSE_random）的中位数为 1.1395（均值 1.4277，IQR [1.0417, 1.4374]，范围 [0.9406, 5.2645]）。在外部领域迁移下，性能下降尤其明显（中位数 ΔR2 = 0.6399，中位数 RR_RMSE = 1.8199）。在含有共享相同滴定参考值的重复扫描的食用植物油数据中，随机交叉验证导致非线性模型的性能出现灾难性膨胀：kNN 从表观 R2 = 0.8865（RMSE 5.40 meq O2/kg）降至 −2.1443（RMSE 28.43 meq O2/kg；RR_RMSE = 5.265），Random Forest 从 R2 = 0.8437 降至 −0.5806（RR_RMSE = 3.180）。这种重复泄漏完全反转了算法排名（Spearman ρ = −0.886，p = 0.019；Kendall τ = −0.733，p = 0.056）。算法在外部迁移下的稳健性具有领域特异性：在芒果季节迁移中，Ridge 是最具韧性的模型（R2 = 0.6690，而树集成模型的 R2 ≈ 0.13–0.17）；相反，未校准的玉米仪器迁移导致线性模型严重退化，原因是未校正的光谱仪基线偏移（Ridge R2 = −30.04，PLS R2 = −37.05）。相比之下，非线性模型在传感器迁移下的相对退化较小。跨分区最近邻光谱相似性在领域迁移下最多下降 0.0164。在各任务中，这种相似性下降与 kNN 误差膨胀呈探索性正相关（Pearson r = 0.739，Spearman ρ = 0.912），与一种光谱邻近机制一致：较高的光学相似性使灵活模型能够插值训练点，而不是学习可迁移的化学关系。结论：随机逐行验证会造成严重的验证诱导乐观偏差、扭曲算法排名，并奖励记忆实验伪影的模型。报告标准、强制性的样本级划分清单，以及常规纳入 kNN 作为诊断哨兵，对于恢复机器学习在食品分析中的方法学完整性和可部署性至关重要。
items.author_line: Ketney Otto

items.title: A bench-scale, continuous reactor for reductive polyolefin depolymerization
items.abstract_or_text: Catalytic deconstruction of polyolefins is central to chemical recycling, but most laboratory studies use batch reactors that obscure kinetics and limit reproducibility. Flow operation enables rigorous measurement of rates and selectivities, yet processing viscous polymer melts at small scales remains challenging. Here we present a laboratory-scale flow reactor that couples a hydraulic melt pump to a stirred-tank vessel, enabling continuous and semi-continuous operation at high pressure. The system achieves pseudo-steady state, where volatile production rates reflect C–C scission kinetics, validated by a first-principles model. Using this reactor with H-ZSM-5, we demonstrate three features of polyethylene hydrocracking difficult to probe in batch systems, namely that alkene selectivities exceed batch reactions by nearly tenfold, hydrogen availability within the melt governs the balance between alkene and alkane products, and catalyst acidity and crystallite size jointly tune this product balance through intermediate diffusion from the zeolite. This reactor provides a platform for kinetic and mechanistic studies of catalytic polymer deconstruction.
items.summary_zh: 作者构建了一个台式连续流反应器，将液压熔体泵与搅拌釜耦合，在高压下实现聚烯烃还原解聚的连续或半连续操作。该系统达到拟稳态，并用第一性原理模型验证；在 H-ZSM-5 催化的 polyethylene hydrocracking 中揭示了烯烃选择性、熔体内氢可用性及催化剂酸性和晶粒尺寸的作用。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该平台解决了黏稠聚合物熔体难以连续处理、批式反应难以解析动力学的问题，为化学回收中的速率和选择性研究提供了更可重复的实验基础。摘要没有显示机器学习或大规模材料筛选，AI 相关性弱于其他入选项；其长期稳定运行和放大适用性仍待验证。
items.abstract_zh: 聚烯烃的催化解构是化学回收的核心，但大多数实验室研究使用批式反应器，这会掩盖动力学并限制可重复性。流动操作能够严格测量速率和选择性，但在小尺度下处理黏稠聚合物熔体仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出一种实验室规模的流动反应器，将液压熔体泵与搅拌釜耦合，从而实现高压下的连续和半连续操作。该系统达到拟稳态，此时挥发性产物的生成速率反映 C–C 断裂动力学，并通过第一性原理模型得到验证。使用该反应器和 H-ZSM-5，我们展示了聚乙烯加氢裂解中三个在批式系统难以探究的特征：烯烃选择性几乎比批式反应高十倍；熔体内氢的可用性决定烯烃和烷烃产物之间的平衡；催化剂酸性和晶粒尺寸通过沸石内部的中间体扩散共同调节这种产物平衡。该反应器为催化聚合物解构的动力学和机理研究提供了平台。
items.author_line: Griffin Drake, Juliana Lu-Yang, Anna E. Brenner, Joel Miscall, Gregg T. Beckham, Yuriy Román-Leshkov

items.title: Optimized Multiple Circular Sequence Alignment for Cyclic Peptide Motif Discovery
items.abstract_or_text: Head-to-tail (H2T) cyclized peptides are an increasingly important modality in drug discovery, combining high target affinity and selectivity with metabolic sta-bility. Because their underlying chemistry is still that of a linear amino-acid chain, their linear sequence representation is the native input format of main- stream sequence generative models now driving de novo peptide design (Slough et al., 2018; Rettie et al., 2025a;b). Discovering the conserved motifs responsible for a family's function across a library of such candidates requires a multiple sequence alignment (MSA). Because a cyclic peptide can be linearised at any residue, the alignment must additionally solve for the unknown rotation of each sequence, which is the multiple circular sequence alignment (MCSA) problem. However, leading MCSA heuristics (e.g. Ayad & Pissis, 2017) were tuned for the genomic regime (a few tens of long sequences) and become prohibitively slow on the cyclic peptide library regime (hundreds to thousands of shorter sequences). We close this gap by identifying quality-preserving optimisation opportunities, notably the library-scale preset tailored to short-sequence inputs (algorithmic details in Appendix A), and by adding an orthogonal multi-core and SIMD backend for further performance tuning, which gives near-linear thread scaling on the pairwise-comparison stage. We validate the pipeline on a library of 1,000 H2T cyclized peptides of length 18 targeting the oncoprotein Mouse double minute 2 human homolog (MDM2) produced by an internal peptide-design engine. In this practical setup, the optimised MCSA recovers the underlying positional motif of MDM2 binders at the same fidelity as the original MCSA implementation while running over 650x faster. Our optimised MCSA tool thus enables library-scale cyclic peptide sequence alignment and is publicly available at https://github.com/IVB-Generative-Biology/mars-turbo.
items.summary_zh: 作者针对环肽的 multiple circular sequence alignment（MCSA）问题，对现有启发式算法进行面向短序列库的优化，并加入多核和 SIMD 后端。在 1,000 条长度为 18、靶向 MDM2 的 head-to-tail（H2T）环肽库上，优化工具以相同 motif 恢复保真度实现超过 650 倍加速，并公开发布。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工具解决了环肽序列可从任意残基线性化导致的旋转不确定性，为大规模环肽设计库中的 motif 发现提供了实用基础。验证主要依赖一个内部设计引擎生成的单一 MDM2 库，尚不足以证明对其他靶点、长度或环化方式普遍适用。
items.abstract_zh: 头尾（H2T）环化肽正成为药物发现中越来越重要的形式，其兼具较高的靶标亲和力和选择性以及代谢稳定性。由于其底层化学仍然是线性氨基酸链，线性序列表示是当前推动从头肽设计的主流序列生成模型的原生输入格式（Slough et al., 2018；Rettie et al., 2025a;b）。要在这类候选物库中发现负责某一功能的家族保守基序，需要进行多序列比对（MSA）。由于环肽可以从任意残基处线性化，比对还必须同时解决每条序列的未知旋转问题，这就是多重环形序列比对（MCSA）问题。然而，领先的 MCSA 启发式方法（例如 Ayad & Pissis, 2017）是针对基因组场景调优的，即少量较长序列；在数百到数千条较短序列组成的环肽库场景中，其速度会变得难以接受。我们通过识别保持质量的优化机会弥合了这一差距，特别是针对短序列输入的库规模预设（算法细节见 Appendix A），并加入正交的多核和 SIMD 后端以进一步调优性能；后者在成对比较阶段实现了近线性的线程扩展。我们在一个由内部肽设计引擎生成的 1,000 条 H2T 环化肽库上验证了该流程；这些肽的长度为 18，靶向癌蛋白 Mouse double minute 2 human homolog（MDM2）。在这一实际设置中，优化后的 MCSA 以与原始 MCSA 实现相同的保真度恢复了 MDM2 结合肽的潜在位置基序，同时运行速度提高了 650 倍以上。因此，优化后的 MCSA 工具实现了库规模的环肽序列比对，并已公开发布于 https://github.com/IVB-Generative-Biology/mars-turbo。

items.title: Integrating structural homology with deep learning to achieve highly accurate protein-protein interface prediction for the human interactome
items.abstract_or_text: A significant portion of disease-causing mutations occur at protein-protein interfaces however, the number of structurally resolved multi-protein complexes is extremely small. Here we present a computational pipeline, PIONEER2, that integrates 3D structural similarity with geometric deep learning to accurately predict protein binding partner-specific interfacial residues. We compare the performance of PIONEER2 to that of AlphaFold3 and found, using a test set of PDB structures, that their performance is quite similar. However, about 20% of AlphaFold3 predictions for protein-protein complexes in the PDB have AlphaFold3 ranking scores below 0.5, which indicates an uncertain model. For these structures, PIONEER2 outperforms AlphaFold3 at discriminating interfacial from non-interfacial residues. Further, about half of the AlphaFold3 ranking scores on high confidence protein-protein interactions (PPIs) not associated with a PDB structure are below 0.5 indicating that PIONEER2 offers superior interface prediction for a large number of PPIs for which structures are not available. We created a comprehensive 3D structurally informed interactome encompassing all 352,124 experimentally detected binary human PPIs in the current literature and made PIONEER2 interface predictions for each. We experimentally validated these predictions by generating 1,866 mutations and testing their disruptive impact on 5,010 mutation-interaction pairs. PIONEER2-predicted interfaces are found to be comparable to PDB structures in their ability to predict disruptive mutations while AlphaFold3 performance is reduced. Similarly, PIONEER2-predicted interfaces outperform AlphaFold3 in accounting for the depletion of non-deleterious common population variants and the enrichment of disease-related mutations on protein surfaces. Overall, our results suggest that PIONEER2-predicted interfaces provide a valuable tool for studying disease etiology, advancing personalized medicine and for fundamental research. We further implemented PIONEER2 as a user-friendly web server (https://pioneer2.yulab.org) platform for users to explore our 3D interactome models and conduct genome-wide functional genomics studies.
items.summary_zh: PIONEER2 将结构同源性与几何深度学习结合，用于预测人类互作组中的蛋白质界面。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作覆盖352,124个实验检测的人类二元PPI，并通过1,866个突变和5,010个突变—互作组合进行实验验证，兼具大规模结构建模、疾病突变解释和可复现的公开服务器。
items.abstract_zh: 相当一部分致病突变发生在蛋白质—蛋白质界面，但结构解析的多蛋白复合物数量极少。在此，我们提出计算流程 PIONEER2，将三维结构相似性与几何深度学习相结合，以准确预测特定蛋白质结合伙伴的界面残基。我们将 PIONEER2 与 AlphaFold3 进行比较，并使用一组 PDB 结构作为测试集，发现二者性能相当。然而，在 PDB 中蛋白质—蛋白质复合物的 AlphaFold3 预测结果中，约20%的排序分数低于0.5，提示模型存在不确定性。对于这些结构，PIONEER2 在区分界面残基与非界面残基方面优于 AlphaFold3。此外，在没有相应PDB结构的高置信度蛋白质—蛋白质互作中，约一半的 AlphaFold3 排序分数低于0.5，表明对于大量缺少结构的PPI，PIONEER2能够提供更优的界面预测。我们建立了一个全面的、具有三维结构信息的人类互作组，涵盖当前文献中实验检测到的全部352,124个二元人类PPI，并为每个PPI生成了 PIONEER2 界面预测。我们通过生成1,866个突变并检测其对5,010个突变—互作组合的破坏作用，对这些预测进行了实验验证。PIONEER2预测的界面在预测破坏性突变方面与PDB结构相当，而 AlphaFold3 的表现较低。同样，与 AlphaFold3 相比，PIONEER2 在解释蛋白质表面非有害常见人群变异的耗竭以及疾病相关突变的富集方面表现更好。总体而言，我们的结果表明，PIONEER2预测的界面可用于研究疾病病因、推进个体化医学和开展基础研究。我们还将 PIONEER2 实现为用户友好的网络服务器（https://pioneer2.yulab.org），供用户探索三维互作组模型并开展全基因组功能基因组学研究。
items.author_line: Xiong, D., Torres, M., Murray, D., Zhang, Z., Li, L., Naravane, A. C., Fragoza, R., Honig, B., Yu, H.

items.title: Gravlax: an annotation-independent molecular evidence archive for single-cell RNA-seq
items.abstract_or_text: A cell-by-gene count matrix is the artifact of a single-cell RNA-seq experiment that is most often stored, shared, and reanalyzed. It is the output of a computation whose inputs are the sequenced molecules and a gene annotation, and while the molecules never change, the annotation is revised continually. Once the matrix has been produced, the evidence behind it can no longer be reinterpreted. Recovering that evidence means returning to raw reads or alignments that are large, costly to process, and frequently unavailable. We ask whether a concise representation of the molecules themselves can be extracted once and reused indefinitely, to quantify under any future annotation, to query and discover features that no annotation yet describes, and to pool evidence across cells and samples. Our starting observation is that the procedures that turn alignments into counts, gene assignment and UMI collapse, never read most of what an alignment file contains. They consume relations among molecules such as shared genomic geometry, shared placements, barcode identity, and the equality or near-equality of UMIs. We show that these relations form a statistic that is sufficient for such consumers, and we design a compact, seekable, content-authenticated archive that stores them while deferring every annotation-dependent decision to analysis time. Archives compose into content-addressed collections that route cohort queries to the molecules that can answer them without copying molecules. We implement these ideas in a tool called gravlax. Across four human 10x 3' datasets, gravlax archives require 11--18 bits per read and are 9.0--12.7x smaller than tag-preserving CRAM. Count matrices replayed from an archive deviate from direct STARsolo quantification by 0.24--0.75% of normalized UMI mass, whereas changing GENCODE v32 to v49 moves 2.12--4.64%, and quantification replay is 34--82x faster than STARsolo at matched thread budgets. A federated index over eight archives occupies 2.96% of their size, answers a 96-query junction panel 2.59x faster than the archives alone, and screens the cohort genome-wide for unannotated splice events that recur across donors in just 9 seconds. Because the molecules are retained, the archives also answer questions the matrix has discarded. An analysis of four peripheral-blood archives recovers a validated FYB1 immune-cell splicing switch, a cross-fitted fragment model appropriate for 3' chemistry reveals an eight-donor shift in NTRK2 terminal-isoform usage from astrocyte and neural-stem-cell populations to mature neurons, and pooling evidence across cells within the context of an expectation-maximization algorithm recovers 75--98% of withheld multi-gene molecule labels. Gravlax is open source, implemented in Rust, licensed under the BSD 3-clause license, and available at https://github.com/COMBINE-lab/gravlax.
items.summary_zh: Gravlax 将单细胞RNA测序中的分子证据以与注释无关的形式保存，支持未来注释下的快速重分析。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工具在4个10x 3'人类数据集上实现了压缩、快速回放、跨队列查询和未注释剪接事件发现，并以 Rust 和 BSD 3-clause license 开源，复现路径清晰。
items.abstract_zh: 细胞—基因计数矩阵是单细胞 RNA 测序实验中最常被存储、共享和重新分析的产物。它是一个计算过程的输出，该过程的输入包括测序分子和基因注释；而分子本身不会改变，注释却会持续修订。一旦计数矩阵生成，其背后的证据就无法再被重新解释。要恢复这些证据，必须回到原始 reads 或比对结果，而它们体积庞大、处理成本高，并且经常无法获得。我们提出这样一个问题：能否在一次性提取分子本身的简洁表示后，长期重复使用它，在任意未来注释下进行定量，查询和发现当前注释尚未描述的特征，并汇总多个细胞和样本中的证据？我们的出发点是，许多将比对结果转换为计数的步骤，包括基因分配和 UMI 合并，从不读取比对文件中的大部分内容。它们只使用分子之间的关系，例如共享的基因组几何关系、共享的定位、条形码身份以及 UMI 的相等性或近似相等性。我们显示，这些关系构成了对这些处理步骤足够的统计量，并设计了一个紧凑、可检索、具有内容认证能力的档案，将这些关系保存下来，同时把所有依赖注释的决策推迟到分析时进行。档案可以组合成基于内容寻址的集合，将队列查询路由至能够回答问题的分子，而无需复制分子。我们将这些思想实现为工具 gravlax。在4个人类 10x 3' 数据集上，gravlax 档案每条 read 需要11--18 bits，比保留标签的 CRAM 小9.0--12.7倍。由档案回放得到的计数矩阵，与直接 STARsolo 定量相比，偏离的标准化 UMI 总量为0.24--0.75%；而将 GENCODE v32 更换为 v49 会产生2.12--4.64%的变化。在相同线程预算下，定量回放速度比 STARsolo 快34--82倍。由8个档案构成的联邦索引仅占其大小的2.96%，对于包含96个查询的 junction panel，其响应速度比单独使用档案快2.59倍，并且能够在9秒内对整个队列进行全基因组筛查，以发现供体之间反复出现的未注释剪接事件。由于保留了分子，档案还可以回答计数矩阵已经丢失的问题。对4个外周血档案的分析恢复了经过验证的 FYB1 免疫细胞剪接开关；适用于3' chemistry的交叉拟合片段模型显示，在8名供体中，NTRK2 末端异构体的使用从星形胶质细胞和神经干细胞群转向成熟神经元；在期望最大化算法中汇总细胞内证据后，可恢复75--98%的被隐藏多基因分子标签。Gravlax 为开源软件，使用 Rust 实现，采用 BSD 3-clause license，并可通过 https://github.com/COMBINE-lab/gravlax 获取。

items.title: Identifying Family Relationships from Electronic Health Records: A Machine Learning Approach
items.abstract_or_text: Objective: To develop and evaluate machine learning methods for automated identification of family relationships from electronic health records (EHRs). We employed Random Forest classifiers to identify five relationship types: Mother-Child, Father-Child, Sibling-Sibling, Twin-Twin, and Partner-Partner, using a four-stage iterative refinement process to improve precision for patient-centered outcomes research (PCOR) and healthcare applications. Materials and Methods: We used two large-scale Indiana datasets: the Indiana Network for Patient Care (INPC), comprising approximately 15 million unique individuals across approximately 45 million medical records, and the Indiana Natality dataset (birth certificates, 1970-2024), which served as the gold standard. Positive cases were derived by linking verified relationships from Natality records to INPC using a shared Global Identifier. Negative cases were drawn from a three-tier blocking strategy combined with sliding window restriction and similarity scoring, which together reduced the comparison space from over 1014 potential pairs to approximately 121 million candidates. Five Random Forest classifiers underwent four- stage iterative refinement: initial training, feature removal for multicollinearity, feature engineering to address systematic errors, and training-data refinement restricted to relationship pairs with at least one shared contact feature. Results: The models achieved precision of 0.92 to 1.00, recall of 0.97 to 1.00, and F1 scores of 0.94 to 1.00 across all relationship types (Mother-Child 0.97, Father-Child 0.98, Sibling-Sibling 0.98, Twin-Twin 1.00, Partner-Partner 0.94). Between 15% and 78% of Natality-verified relationships lacked any shared contact information in INPC and were structurally undetectable by record linkage; restricting training and evaluation to linkable pairs improved precision, and training-data refinement improved F1-scores by a further 0.02-0.04 for the Mother-Child, Father-Child, and Sibling models. High-confidence predictions (probability [≥] 0.9) captured 77-99% of true positives. Age difference was the primary predictor for parent- child and twin relationships, while phone number similarity was most important for siblings. Discussion: The framework identifies family relationships from standard demographic fields available in most EHR systems. The iterative refinement approach shows how systematic error analysis can guide 1 methodological improvements. Training-data refinement addresses a constraint in EHR-based family linkage: not all verified biological relationships have overlapping demographic footprints in healthcare data. Unlike rule-based approaches, the framework provides probability scores that enable configurable deployment thresholds. Conclusion: The Random Forest models demonstrate high performance suitable for large-scale research deployment and are ready for testing in clinical applications rather than immediate widespread clinical use. The methodology can be adapted to other EHR systems, supporting family-centered study design in patient- centered outcomes research. Keywords: family linkage, electronic health records, machine learning, Random Forest, record linkage, patient-centered outcomes research, health informatics
items.summary_zh: 基于15 million名个体和约45 million份医疗记录的EHR家系关系识别框架。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究展示了大规模真实世界数据上的迭代式记录链接，并明确指出缺少共享联系信息的真实家系关系在结构上不可检测，避免将高指标泛化为普遍临床可用性。
items.abstract_zh: 目的：开发并评估利用电子健康记录（EHR）自动识别家系关系的机器学习方法。我们采用 Random Forest 分类器识别五类关系：Mother-Child、Father-Child、Sibling-Sibling、Twin-Twin 和 Partner-Partner，并通过四阶段迭代优化流程提高其在以患者为中心的结局研究（PCOR）和医疗应用中的精确率。材料与方法：我们使用两个大规模 Indiana 数据集：Indiana Network for Patient Care（INPC），包含约15 million名独特个体和约45 million份医疗记录；以及 Indiana Natality 数据集（1970-2024年出生证明），后者作为金标准。阳性案例通过将 Natality 记录中已验证的关系与 INPC 通过共享 Global Identifier 进行链接获得。阴性案例来自三层 blocking 策略，并结合滑动窗口限制和相似度评分；这些步骤将比较空间从超过1014个潜在配对缩小到约121 million个候选。五个 Random Forest 分类器经历了四阶段迭代优化：初始训练、为处理多重共线性而移除特征、为解决系统误差而进行特征工程，以及将训练数据优化限制在至少共享一个联系特征的关系配对上。结果：在所有关系类型中，模型的精确率为0.92至1.00，召回率为0.97至1.00，F1分数为0.94至1.00（Mother-Child为0.97，Father-Child为0.98，Sibling-Sibling为0.98，Twin-Twin为1.00，Partner-Partner为0.94）。在 Natality 验证的关系中，有15%至78%在 INPC 中没有任何共享联系信息，因而在结构上无法通过记录链接检测；将训练和评估限制在可链接配对上提高了精确率，而训练数据优化又使 Mother-Child、Father-Child 和 Sibling 模型的F1分数进一步提高0.02-0.04。高置信度预测（概率 [≥] 0.9）覆盖了77-99%的真阳性。年龄差异是 parent-child 和 twin 关系的主要预测因子，而电话号码相似性对 sibling 关系最为重要。讨论：该框架利用大多数EHR系统中可获得的标准人口统计字段识别家系关系。迭代优化方法显示，系统误差分析能够指导方法学改进。训练数据优化处理了EHR家系链接中的一个限制：并非所有已验证的生物学关系在医疗数据中都具有重叠的人口统计特征。不同于基于规则的方法，该框架提供概率分数，从而支持可配置的部署阈值。结论：Random Forest 模型展示出适合大规模研究部署的高性能，并已准备好进行临床应用测试，但尚不适合立即广泛临床使用。该方法可适配其他EHR系统，为以患者为中心的结局研究中的家系研究设计提供支持。关键词：家系链接、电子健康记录、机器学习、Random Forest、记录链接、以患者为中心的结局研究、健康信息学
items.author_line: Pundir, A., Hill, A., Kahn, M. G., Kwan, B. M., Lindberg, D. M., Grannis, S. J., Schleyer, T. K., Schilling, L. M., Kautz, S. V., Ong, T. C.

items.title: CUBE: Multimodal Representation Learning Reveals Biological Structure Across Histomorphology, Spatial Protein Phenotypes, and Transcriptome-Associated Signals
items.abstract_or_text: Integrating histological, spatial protein, and transcriptomic information into a biologically grounded representation remains challenging because these modalities are rarely available as fully paired measurements, while existing computational approaches are commonly developed around individual modality pairs. To address this, we present CUBE (Colorectal Universal Representation & Bridge Encoder), a multimodal representation-learning framework that uses hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) histology as a bridge to integrate spatial protein phenotypes with transcriptome-associated information from incompletely paired data. CUBE independently learns representations from H&E-multiplex immunohistochemistry (mIHC) and H&E-pseudo-ST relationships and integrates them through attention-based fusion with biological grounding from mIHC-derived concepts. The H&E-mIHC representation supported competitive spatial protein reconstruction, while the pseudo-ST-supervised representation transferred to experimentally measured Visium HD spatial transcriptomics data and improved further after decoder-only calibration with the encoder frozen. Importantly, the fused representation retained biological information beyond its direct training targets, capturing immune-epithelial spatial organization and an independently measured ECM-receptor interaction transcriptomic program. Together, these findings demonstrate that separately paired spatial modalities can be organized through histology into a biologically structured and testable multimodal representation, providing a proof-of-concept strategy for multimodal tissue learning without requiring fully paired molecular measurements.
items.summary_zh: CUBE（Colorectal Universal Representation & Bridge Encoder）以 hematoxylin and eosin（H&E）组织学为桥梁，整合空间蛋白表型与转录组相关信息。模型分别学习 H&E-mIHC 和 H&E-pseudo-ST 关系，再通过 attention-based fusion 融合；其表示可支持空间蛋白重建，并迁移到实验测量的 Visium HD spatial transcriptomics 数据。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法面向多组学数据不完全配对这一实际瓶颈，用组织学建立可检验的跨模态桥接，并在独立实验测量数据上进行迁移。当前结果仍是 proof-of-concept，数据来自特定组织和配对关系，跨癌种、平台及临床队列的稳健性尚未确定。
items.abstract_zh: 将组织学、空间蛋白和转录组信息整合为具有生物学基础的表示仍然具有挑战性，因为这些模态很少以完全配对的测量形式获得，而现有计算方法通常围绕单独的模态对开发。为解决这一问题，我们提出 CUBE（Colorectal Universal Representation & Bridge Encoder），一种多模态表示学习框架，以 hematoxylin and eosin（H&E）组织学为桥梁，从不完全配对的数据中整合空间蛋白表型与转录组相关信息。CUBE 分别从 H&E-multiplex immunohistochemistry（mIHC）关系和 H&E-pseudo-ST 关系中学习表示，并通过基于 attention 的融合以及来自 mIHC 的概念所提供的生物学 grounding 将其整合。H&E-mIHC 表示支持具有竞争力的空间蛋白重建，而由 pseudo-ST 监督的表示能够迁移到实验测量的 Visium HD spatial transcriptomics 数据；在冻结编码器后仅校准解码器，还能进一步改善表现。重要的是，融合后的表示保留了超出其直接训练目标的生物学信息，捕捉到了免疫–上皮空间组织以及一个独立测量的 ECM-receptor interaction 转录组程序。总的来说，这些结果表明，可以通过组织学将分别配对的空间模态组织为具有生物学结构且可检验的多模态表示，为不要求完全配对分子测量的多模态组织学习提供了一种概念验证策略。
items.author_line: Ge, Z., Cai, H.

items.title: miRstring: An RNA language model enables mature miRNA decoding and artificial small RNA design across species
items.abstract_or_text: MicroRNAs (miRNAs) are processed from structured precursors and subsequently loaded into Argonaute proteins to repress target mRNAs. Yet generalized computational frameworks capable of decoding mature miRNAs from precursor context remain limited, constraining both cross-species annotation and rational artificial miRNA design. Here, we present miRstring, a biogenesis-aware RNA language framework that decodes the four boundaries defining the miRNA/miRNA duplex. Trained on 77,708 miRNA precursors spanning 414 species, miRstring outperforms existing methods under family- and species-held-out evaluations and accurately identifies the first nucleotide of mature miRNAs. Importantly, its attention mechanism highlights the miRNA/ miRNA* boundary sites cleaved by endonucleases, indicating that the model captures biologically meaningful features. Furthermore, we employed miRstring to design optimal pre-miRNA scaffolds for artificial miRNAs and validated its efficacy in repressing target mRNAs. Taken together, miRstring establishes a scalable route from cross-species mature-miRNA annotation to predictive design, enabling artificial intelligence-driven miRNA engineering and extending computational miRNA analysis toward broadly applicable small-RNA biotechnology.
items.summary_zh: miRstring 是一个具有生物发生感知能力的 RNA language model，用于跨物种成熟 miRNA 解码和人工小RNA设计。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 模型在覆盖414个物种的77,708条 miRNA 前体上训练，并通过跨家族、跨物种留出评测和靶mRNA抑制实验，将序列预测延伸到人工 miRNA 设计。
items.abstract_zh: MicroRNAs（miRNAs）由具有结构的前体加工产生，随后装载到 Argonaute 蛋白中，以抑制靶 mRNA。然而，能够从前体背景中解码成熟 miRNA 的通用计算框架仍然有限，这限制了跨物种注释和人工 miRNA 的理性设计。在此，我们提出 miRstring，这是一个具有生物发生感知能力的 RNA language framework，可解码定义 miRNA/miRNA duplex 的四个边界。miRstring 在覆盖414个物种的77,708条 miRNA 前体上训练，在按家族和物种留出的评测中优于现有方法，并能够准确识别成熟 miRNA 的第一个核苷酸。值得注意的是，其注意力机制突出显示了由核酸内切酶切割的 miRNA/miRNA* 边界位点，表明该模型捕获了具有生物学意义的特征。此外，我们利用 miRstring 为人工 miRNA 设计了最优 pre-miRNA 支架，并验证了其抑制靶 mRNA 的效力。综上，miRstring 建立了一条从跨物种成熟 miRNA 注释到预测性设计的可扩展路径，支持人工智能驱动的 miRNA 工程，并将计算 miRNA 分析拓展至具有广泛应用潜力的小RNA生物技术。

items.title: Artificial intelligence in onco-anaesthesia: Current applications, challenges, and future directions.
items.abstract_or_text: Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming onco-anaesthesia by shifting practice from reactive physiological management toward predictive and precision-based care. This review outlines current AI applications across the perioperative cancer pathway. Preoperatively, machine learning and deep learning models enhance risk stratification through automated frailty assessment, electronic health record phenotyping, and prediction of cancer-specific outcomes. Intraoperatively, AI-enabled technologies such as closed-loop anaesthesia delivery systems, predictive haemodynamic monitoring, and automated depth-of-anaesthesia control optimize drug dosing, reduce physiological stress, and may help preserve perioperative immune function, with potential implications for long-term oncologic outcomes. Postoperatively, AI-driven integration of multimodal data-including genomics, radiomics, wearable biosignals, and high-resolution physiological waveforms-facilitates early detection of complications such as delirium, persistent pain, acute kidney injury, and anastomotic leakage. The review also examines the role of AI in evaluating the "onco-anaesthesia hypothesis" by clarifying links between anaesthetic techniques, inflammation, and cancer recurrence. Despite these advances, significant challenges persist, including data heterogeneity, limited generalisability, algorithmic opacity, regulatory uncertainty, and ethical concerns related to equity and clinical implementation. Future progress will depend on explainable AI, federated learning, real-time clinical decision-support systems, and validation through large, prospective studies to fully realise AI's potential in personalised onco-anaesthetic care.

items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是本批次唯一的 peer_reviewed 项目，系统梳理了从术前到术后的AI应用与转化障碍；其结论主要是综述性证据，不应视为新的临床试验结果。
items.abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）正在改变肿瘤麻醉学，将实践从反应式生理管理转向预测性和精准化护理。本综述概述了AI在癌症围术期全过程中的当前应用。术前，机器学习和深度学习模型通过自动化衰弱评估、电子健康记录表型分析以及癌症特异性结局预测，增强风险分层。术中，闭环麻醉给药系统、预测性血流动力学监测和自动化麻醉深度控制等AI赋能技术能够优化药物剂量、降低生理应激，并可能有助于保留围术期免疫功能，从而可能影响长期肿瘤学结局。术后，AI驱动的多模态数据整合——包括基因组学、影像组学、可穿戴设备生物信号和高分辨率生理波形——有助于早期发现谵妄、持续性疼痛、急性肾损伤和吻合口漏等并发症。本综述还讨论了AI在评估“肿瘤麻醉学假说”中的作用，即阐明麻醉技术、炎症和癌症复发之间的联系。尽管取得了这些进展，仍存在重大挑战，包括数据异质性、有限的泛化性、算法不透明、监管不确定性以及与公平性和临床实施相关的伦理问题。未来进展将取决于可解释AI、联邦学习、实时临床决策支持系统以及大型前瞻性研究验证，只有这样才能充分实现AI在个体化肿瘤麻醉护理中的潜力。

items.title: Computational design of metalloproteases
items.abstract_or_text: Although significant progress has been made in creating de novo metalloenzymes that hydrolyze activated esters, the energetically demanding cleavage of amide bonds has remained a major challenge for enzyme design: amide bonds are significantly more stable than ester bonds, the amine leaving groups in proteins are not activated, and peptide substrates are flexible making them difficult to bind precisely. Here, we report the de novo design of zinc proteases from minimal catalytic motifs using RoseTTAFold Diffusion 2 for Molecular Interfaces, optimized for both enzyme and protein-protein interaction design. Of 135 computational designs experimentally tested, 36% had activity and cleaved precisely at the intended site. The most active design accelerates peptide bond hydrolysis by more than 10^8-fold relative to the uncatalyzed reaction, and by over 10^10-fold following the introduction of four point mutations that enhanced active-site preorganization4. Building on these capabilities, we designed metalloproteases that specifically cleave human TDP-43, the amyloid-{beta} peptide, and serum amyloid A with rate accelerations up to 9.2x10^8-fold over background. We illustrate the potential of our approach for bio-orthogonal control over cell state by generating caged cytokines and caged receptor antagonists that are selectively unmasked by our designed proteases. These results demonstrate that de novo enzyme design has advanced well beyond model reactions with activated substrates and open the door to design of proficient metallohydrolases for a wide range of applications in medicine and bioremediation.
items.summary_zh: 作者使用 RoseTTAFold Diffusion 2 for Molecular Interfaces，从最小催化基序出发进行锌金属蛋白酶从头设计。在实验测试的 135 个计算设计中，36% 具有活性并能在预定位置精准切割；进一步设计的金属蛋白酶可切割人 TDP-43、amyloid-{beta} peptide 和 serum amyloid A，并用于选择性解笼蔽细胞因子和受体拮抗剂。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是从模型驱动设计走向功能性金属酶和生物医学应用的强验证案例，实验命中率和底物范围都具有参考价值。需要注意的是，结果仍来自特定设计流程和有限数量的蛋白酶，细胞内效果、免疫安全性及体内可控性尚未由摘要证明。
items.abstract_zh: 尽管在制造能够水解活化酯的从头设计金属酶方面已经取得了显著进展，但对酰胺键进行能量要求较高的切割一直是酶设计中的重大挑战：酰胺键比酯键稳定得多，蛋白质中的胺离去基团未被活化，而且肽底物具有柔性，难以实现精确结合。在此，我们报告了使用针对 Molecular Interfaces 优化的 RoseTTAFold Diffusion 2，从最小催化基序出发进行从头设计的锌蛋白酶。在实验测试的 135 个计算设计中，36% 具有活性，并在预定位置实现了精准切割。活性最强的设计使肽键水解相对于未催化反应加速超过 10^8 倍；引入增强活性位点预组织的四个点突变后，加速幅度超过 10^10 倍4。在此能力基础上，我们设计了能够特异性切割人 TDP-43、amyloid-{beta} peptide 和 serum amyloid A 的金属蛋白酶，相对于背景反应的速率加速最高达到 9.2x10^8 倍。我们通过生成可由所设计蛋白酶选择性解笼蔽的笼化细胞因子和笼化受体拮抗剂，展示了该方法用于对细胞状态进行生物正交控制的潜力。这些结果表明，从头酶设计已经远远超越了以活化底物为对象的模型反应，并为设计能够高效催化的金属水解酶、用于医学和生物修复等广泛应用打开了道路。

items.title: Enhancing Grignard reactions via anion borrowing in deep eutectic /organic biphasic media
items.abstract_or_text: The rational optimization of the Grignard reaction remains a considerable challenge for synthetic chemists. When assessing nucleophilic additions to unsaturated organic molecules, it has been shown that improved performance can be achieved using deep eutectic solvents (DESs). In this case, a solution of the Grignard in THF is added to the DES containing the substrate under vigorous stirring. In this study, we determine the underlying causes for this beneficial effect by combining ab initio molecular dynamics, QM/MM simulations, and enhanced sampling, using i -PrMgCl and acetophenone as reagents, THF as the organic solvent, and a 1:2 solution of choline chloride:glycerol as the DES. Our results show an increased preference for the Grignard reaction over the formation of by-products originating from a β-H transfer from the isopropyl group with the DES/THF media. This enhanced selectivity stems from the formation of chlorinated dimagnesium entities at the DES interface. While the reaction of a neutral Grignard in bulk THF kinetically favours the β-H transfer, the chlorine enrichment originating from the DES is shown to make the two reactions kinetically more equivalent, and to drastically favor the thermodynamic preference for the Grignard product, a result of increased intramolecular stabilizing interactions. This result is in line with experimental evidence of increased selectivity in the presence of various halide salts. This mechanistic interpretation paves the way for the rational improvement of Grignard reagents, allowing an even broader application of these compounds in these non-conventional solvents.
items.summary_zh: 研究结合从头算分子动力学、QM/MM 模拟和增强采样，分析 i -PrMgCl 与 acetophenone 在 THF 及 choline chloride:glycerol 深共熔/有机双相介质中的 Grignard 反应。结果表明，深共熔介质界面形成的氯化二镁实体提高了目标反应相对于 β-H transfer 副反应的选择性，并与卤化物盐实验结果一致。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把界面离子环境与 Grignard 反应选择性联系起来，为非传统溶剂中的反应优化提供了机制假说。摘要中的实验支持主要是与既有卤化物盐证据的一致性，具体中间体、反应能垒和更广底物范围仍需直接实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: Grignard 反应的理性优化对于合成化学家而言仍然是一个相当大的挑战。在评估对不饱和有机分子的亲核加成时，已有研究表明使用深共熔溶剂（DESs）可以改善性能。在这种情况下，将 Grignard 试剂的 THF 溶液加入含有底物的 DES 中，并进行剧烈搅拌。在本研究中，我们结合从头算分子动力学、QM/MM 模拟和增强采样，使用 i -PrMgCl 和 acetophenone 作为试剂、THF 作为有机溶剂、以及 1:2 的 choline chloride:glycerol 溶液作为 DES，确定这种有利效果的根本原因。结果表明，在 DES/THF 介质中，Grignard 反应相对于由异丙基发生 β-H transfer 所产生副产物的形成具有更高偏好。这种选择性增强源于 DES 界面形成的氯化二镁实体。在体相 THF 中，中性的 Grignard 试剂在动力学上更倾向于 β-H transfer；而来自 DES 的氯富集使两种反应在动力学上更加接近，并由于分子内稳定化相互作用增强，显著提高了 Grignard 产物在热力学上的偏好。这一结果与在各种卤化物盐存在下选择性提高的实验观察一致。这种机制解释为理性改进 Grignard 试剂铺平了道路，使这些试剂能够在这类非常规溶剂中得到更广泛的应用。

items.title: Transferable Graph Neural Network Surrogates for Molecular Dynamics Across Crystal Symmetries
items.abstract_or_text: We present a transferable graph neural network (GNN) surrogate framework for molecular dynamics (MD) that directly predicts atomic displacements and propagates atomistic configurations without explicit force evaluation or numerical time integration. The central objective of this work is to establish whether a common GNN formulation can represent atomic dynamics across materials with fundamentally different crystal symmetries and coordination environments. The same network architecture, feature representation, graph construction, and training protocol are applied without symmetry-specific modification to face-centered cubic (FCC) aluminum, body-centered cubic (BCC) iron, and hexagonal close-packed (HCP) magnesium. Across these distinct elemental and crystallographic systems, the framework achieves position-prediction errors on the order of 10−4 Å 2 and supports stable autoregressive propagation to nanosecond time scales. The predicted trajectories preserve thermodynamic stability, characteristic coordination-shell structure in the radial distribution functions, and temperature-dependent mean-squared-displacement behavior. In particular, the framework captures the closely spaced coordination shells of BCC iron and the anisotropic coordination environment of HCP magnesium without introducing lattice-specific representations. These results demonstrate that direct GNN-based atomic propagation can be formulated as a transferable framework across different elements, lattice symmetries, and coordination geometries, providing a pathway toward generalizable surrogate models for accelerated molecular dynamics.
items.summary_zh: 作者提出可迁移的图神经网络分子动力学替代模型，直接预测原子位移并传播原子构型，无需显式力计算或数值时间积分。在 FCC aluminum、BCC iron 和 HCP magnesium 三种晶体体系中使用相同架构、特征、图构建和训练协议，报告了 10−4 Å 2 量级的位置预测误差，并实现纳秒尺度稳定自回归传播。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究测试了同一 GNN 表示跨元素、晶体对称性和配位环境迁移的可能性，并检查了径向分布函数、热力学稳定性和温度依赖均方位移。摘要未提供与传统力场或长时间真实 MD 的系统对照，纳秒尺度稳定性和物理守恒仍需更严格验证。
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个用于分子动力学（MD）的可迁移图神经网络（GNN）替代模型框架，该框架直接预测原子位移并传播原子构型，无需显式力计算或数值时间积分。工作的核心目标是确定一种通用 GNN 架构能否表示具有根本不同晶体对称性和配位环境的材料中的原子动力学。对于面心立方（FCC）铝、体心立方（BCC）铁和六方密排（HCP）镁，我们使用相同的网络架构、特征表示、图构建和训练协议，未进行针对对称性的修改。在这些不同的元素和晶体体系中，该框架实现了 10−4 Å 2 量级的位置预测误差，并支持传播至纳秒时间尺度的稳定自回归过程。预测轨迹保持了热力学稳定性、径向分布函数中的特征配位壳层结构以及温度依赖的均方位移行为。特别是，该框架在不引入晶格特异性表示的情况下，捕捉到了 BCC 铁中间距接近的配位壳层以及 HCP 镁中的各向异性配位环境。这些结果表明，基于直接 GNN 的原子传播可以构建为一种跨不同元素、晶格对称性和配位几何的可迁移框架，为加速分子动力学的通用替代模型提供了一条路径。
items.author_line: Judah Immanuel, Avik Mahata, Aniruddha Maiti

items.title: Enhancing Linear B-Cell Epitope Prediction via Evolutionary Scale Modeling (ESM-2) and Hybrid Feature Integration
items.abstract_or_text: Experimental identification of B-cell epitopes is time-consuming and resource-intensive, motivating the adoption of computational prediction approaches. This study examines the progression of sequence-based strategies by contrasting traditional machine learning methods (SVM, XGBoost, etc.) and early deep learning techniques (CNN, RNN, etc.) with sophisticated protein language models such as ESM-2. By systematically evaluating multiple feature encodings, including amino acid composition, dipeptide composition, k-mer tokenization, and evolutionary embeddings, we established that capturing both global semantic context and local sequence motifs is essential for robust predictive performance. Optimal performance was achieved using a hybrid framework that combined 15B-parameter ESM-2 embeddings with k-mer features. This hybrid approach achieved an AUC of 0.743 and an MCC of 0.333 on independent validation using an Extra Trees classifier, and an AUC of 0.738 and an MCC of 0.356 using an XGBoost classifier on the same dataset. Our findings indicate that transformer-based embeddings yield enhanced protein representations; however, their predictive efficacy is optimized when integrated with local motifs and ensemble learning, presenting a scalable, high-accuracy alternative to conventional and standalone deep learning frameworks.
items.summary_zh: 研究比较 SVM、XGBoost、CNN、RNN 与 ESM-2 等蛋白序列建模策略，并结合氨基酸组成、二肽组成、k-mer 和 evolutionary embeddings 预测线性 B-cell epitopes。15B-parameter ESM-2 embedding 与 k-mer 特征结合后，在独立验证中取得 AUC 0.743、MCC 0.333（Extra Trees）以及 AUC 0.738、MCC 0.356（XGBoost）。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果说明蛋白语言模型的全局语义表示与局部序列 motif 可能具有互补性，为抗原表位预测提供了可扩展基线。摘要没有说明数据集规模、同源序列去重和跨蛋白家族外推设置，AUC 与 MCC 的独立验证结果仍需谨慎解释。
items.abstract_zh: 实验鉴定 B-cell epitopes 既耗时又耗费资源，因此推动了计算预测方法的采用。本研究考察了基于序列的策略发展，通过比较传统机器学习方法（SVM、XGBoost 等）、早期深度学习技术（CNN、RNN 等）与 ESM-2 等先进蛋白语言模型。通过系统评估多种特征编码方式，包括氨基酸组成、二肽组成、k-mer tokenization 和 evolutionary embeddings，我们确定，同时捕捉全局语义上下文和局部序列 motif 对获得稳健预测性能至关重要。最佳性能由结合 15B-parameter ESM-2 embeddings 与 k-mer 特征的混合框架取得。在独立验证中，使用 Extra Trees classifier 时，该框架达到 AUC 0.743 和 MCC 0.333；使用 XGBoost classifier 在同一数据集上达到 AUC 0.738 和 MCC 0.356。我们的研究结果表明，基于 transformer 的嵌入能够增强蛋白质表示；然而，将其与局部 motif 和 ensemble learning 结合时，预测效果达到最佳，从而为传统方法和单独深度学习框架提供了一种可扩展的高准确率替代方案。

items.title: Evaluation of accelerated whole-body diffusion weighted imaging with deep learning reconstruction in patients with metastatic prostate cancer: assessment of image quality and ADC estimates.
items.abstract_or_text: Objectives: To evaluate the impact of an accelerated whole-body diffusion-weighted MRI (WB-DWI) protocol using deep learning (DL) reconstruction on image quality and apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) quantification in patients with metastatic prostate cancer. Methods: This single-centre prospective study involved two patient cohorts undergoing standard-of-care WB-MRI at 1.5T. The DL WB-DWI acquisition used fewer signal averages and higher parallel imaging acceleration, reconstructed with a research application DL package based on a variational network. In Cohort 1 (n = 10), qualitative assessment of image quality was performed across four anatomical stations using a 4-point Likert scale by two radiologists, blinded to the DWI protocol. In Cohort 2 (n = 20), ADC values were evaluated in hypercellular focal bone metastases (as determined by a radiologist) and compared between the standard and accelerated DL WB-DWI protocols. Image quality scores were analysed using Wilcoxon signed-rank tests (Bonferroni-corrected), and ADC agreement was evaluated via Bland-Altman analysis. Results: Accelerated DL WB-DWI reduced WB-DWI acquisition time by 37% without compromising image quality. Radiologists consistently rated both protocols as good-to-excellent across all image quality metrics. Median ADC estimates in lesions showed no significant difference between protocols; interquartile range of ADC estimates also showed no significant difference. Conclusions: Accelerated DL WB-DWI enables 37% scan time reduction without degrading image quality or affecting ADC estimates of lesions in patients with metastatic prostate cancer. Advances in knowledge: DL-based reconstruction enables faster WB-DWI acquisition without compromising image quality or ADC quantification, supporting clinical implementation in metastatic prostate cancer staging and therapy assessment.
items.summary_zh: 深度学习重建将转移性前列腺癌患者全身DWI采集时间缩短37%，同时保持图像质量和ADC估计稳定。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这项单中心前瞻性研究在两组患者中评估了图像质量与病灶ADC一致性，结果支持进一步开展临床流程验证，但样本量有限且尚未建立临床结局获益。
items.abstract_zh: 目的：评估一种采用深度学习（DL）重建的加速全身弥散加权 MRI（WB-DWI）方案对转移性前列腺癌患者图像质量和表观扩散系数（ADC）定量的影响。方法：这项单中心前瞻性研究纳入两组接受标准诊疗 WB-MRI 的患者。DL WB-DWI 采集使用更少的信号平均次数和更高的并行成像加速，并采用基于变分网络的研究型 DL 软件包进行重建。队列1（n = 10）中，两名对DWI方案设盲的放射科医师使用4点 Likert 量表，在四个解剖部位对图像质量进行定性评估。队列2（n = 20）中，研究者评估高细胞性局灶性骨转移灶中的ADC值（由放射科医师判定），并比较标准 WB-DWI 与加速 DL WB-DWI 方案。图像质量评分采用 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验分析，并进行 Bonferroni 校正；ADC一致性通过 Bland-Altman 分析评估。结果：加速 DL WB-DWI 将全身DWI采集时间缩短37%，且未损害图像质量。放射科医师在所有图像质量指标上均持续将两种方案评为良好至优秀。病灶的ADC估计值在两种方案间无显著差异；ADC估计值的四分位距也无显著差异。结论：加速 DL WB-DWI 能够在不降低图像质量或改变转移性前列腺癌患者病灶ADC估计的情况下，将全身DWI扫描时间缩短37%。知识进展：基于DL的重建能够在不损害图像质量或ADC定量的情况下加快 WB-DWI 采集，为其用于转移性前列腺癌分期和疗效评估的临床实施提供支持。

items.title: Incremental Predictive Value and Representation of Transcriptomic Features for Immunotherapy Response in Advanced Urothelial Carcinoma
items.abstract_or_text: Transcriptomic profiling may improve immunotherapy response prediction, but its incremental value beyond established clinical and tumor biomarkers is unclear. In 298 patients with advanced urothelial carcinoma from IMvigor210, an atezolizumab (PD-L1 inhibitor) trial, we compared knowledge-guided tumor microenvironment gene-set features with data-driven transcriptome-wide gene selection. Knowledge-guided features improved AUPRC by 0.058 beyond clinical variables alone, with smaller gains after including standard biomarkers (TMB, PD-L1; +0.011) and research-enriched biomarkers (neoantigen burden, immune phenotype; +0.016). Data-driven gene selection was unstable across folds (mean Jaccard similarity, 0.227) and, under the clinical-plus-biomarker baseline, yielded an AUPRC 0.150 lower than the knowledge-guided representation. Despite this instability, IL-6/JAK/STAT3 signaling was the most recurrent Hallmark pathway, suggesting pathway-level biological convergence. External evaluation showed a similar pattern: knowledge-guided features improved AUPRC by 0.128 over clinical variables vs. 0.019 over clinical-plus-biomarker baseline. These findings support biologically informed transcriptomic representation when molecular profiling adds value beyond established biomarkers.
items.summary_zh: 在 IMvigor210 的298名晚期尿路上皮癌患者中，比较知识引导和数据驱动的转录组特征对免疫治疗反应预测的增量价值。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果显示知识引导的通路级表示比不稳定的全转录组特征选择更有增量预测价值，但外部评估和临床部署仍需进一步验证。
items.abstract_zh: 转录组分析可能改善免疫治疗反应预测，但在已有临床和肿瘤生物标志物之外，其增量价值仍不明确。我们使用 IMvigor210（一项 atezolizumab（PD-L1 inhibitor）试验）中298名晚期尿路上皮癌患者的数据，比较了知识引导的肿瘤微环境基因集特征与数据驱动的全转录组基因选择。与仅使用临床变量相比，知识引导特征使 AUPRC 提高0.058；在加入标准生物标志物（TMB、PD-L1）后，增益缩小为+0.011；在加入研究性增强生物标志物（新抗原负荷、免疫表型）后，增益为+0.016。数据驱动的基因选择在不同交叉验证折叠间不稳定（平均 Jaccard 相似度为0.227）；在临床变量加生物标志物的基线之上，其 AUPRC 比知识引导表示低0.150。外部评估显示出类似模式：与仅使用临床变量相比，知识引导特征使 AUPRC 提高0.128，而在临床变量加生物标志物基线之上仅提高0.019。尽管数据驱动选择不稳定，IL-6/JAK/STAT3 signaling 是重复出现最多的 Hallmark pathway，提示通路层面的生物学收敛。这些结果支持在分子分析能够提供额外价值的情况下，采用具有生物学依据的转录组表示。

items.title: SimSJSAlert: A Similarity-Augmented Multi-View Learning Framework with Scaffold Alerts for Drug-Induced Stevens-Johnson Syndrome Risk Assessment
items.abstract_or_text: Stevens-Johnson syndrome (SJS) is a rare, life-threatening adverse drug reaction for which early identification of high-risk drugs remains challenging. In this study, we developed an explainable quantitative structure-toxicity relationship (QSTR) framework for SJS prediction using a multi-view learning framework with 21 molecular representations, including molecular descriptors, fingerprints, transformer-based embeddings, and a molecular similarity representation. Model development and evaluation were designed in accordance with the OECD principles for QSAR validation, incorporating scaffold-aware validation, external evaluation on pharmacovigilance negative-signal compounds, and structural interpretation by integrating SHAP with Bemis-Murcko scaffold enrichment analysis. The proposed framework achieved robust sensitivity and specificity, with molecular similarity consistently improving the identification of SJS-associated compounds. Furthermore, a consensus prediction and scaffold-based prioritization strategy identified several high-risk drugs from the 1 external negative-signal dataset, including cefprozil, tetracycline, and omadacycline, highlighting their potential association with SJS and warranting further pharmacovigilance and experimental investigation. To facilitate practical application, this was deployed as a freely accessible web server, SimSJSAlert (https: //sim-sjs-alert.streamlit.app/), enabling rapid drug-induced SJS risk assessment. The proposed framework combines predictive performance, interpretability, and accessibility to support early SJS risk assessment, pharmacovigilance signal prioritization, and safer drug development.
items.summary_zh: 作者构建 SimSJSAlert，通过融合 21 种分子表示、相似性信息和 scaffold alerts，对药物诱导的 Stevens-Johnson syndrome（SJS）风险进行 QSTR 预测。研究采用 scaffold-aware validation、外部 pharmacovigilance negative-signal 化合物评估及 SHAP 与 Bemis-Murcko scaffold 富集分析，并部署了可公开访问的网页服务器。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把相似性表示、可解释性分析和外部验证结合到罕见但严重的药物不良反应预测中，具有药物安全筛查价值。候选高风险药物仍只是模型和药物警戒信号，不能直接视为因果关系或临床风险结论，需进一步药理和实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: Stevens-Johnson syndrome（SJS）是一种罕见且危及生命的药物不良反应，早期识别高风险药物仍然具有挑战性。在本研究中，我们开发了一个可解释的定量构效关系毒性（QSTR）框架，用于预测 SJS 风险。该框架采用多视图学习方法，整合了 21 种分子表示，包括分子描述符、指纹、基于 transformer 的嵌入以及分子相似性表示。模型开发和评估遵循 OECD 的 QSAR 验证原则，包括 scaffold-aware validation、在 pharmacovigilance negative-signal 化合物上的外部评估，以及通过将 SHAP 与 Bemis-Murcko scaffold 富集分析结合进行结构解释。所提出的框架取得了稳健的敏感度和特异度，其中分子相似性持续提高了对 SJS 相关化合物的识别能力。此外，共识预测和基于 scaffold 的优先级排序策略从 1 个外部 negative-signal 数据集中识别出若干高风险药物，包括 cefprozil、tetracycline 和 omadacycline，提示它们可能与 SJS 相关，并值得进一步开展药物警戒和实验研究。为促进实际应用，该方法被部署为免费可访问的网页服务器 SimSJSAlert（https: //sim-sjs-alert.streamlit.app/），可用于快速评估药物诱导的 SJS 风险。所提出的框架结合了预测性能、可解释性和可访问性，可支持早期 SJS 风险评估、药物警戒信号优先级排序和更安全的药物开发。
items.author_line: Huynh Anh Duy, Sastiya Kampaengsri, Supreeya Paiboon, Tarapong Srisongkram

items.title: A lifespan single-cell atlas of the human developing hippocampus benchmarks familial Alzheimer's disease brain organoids.
items.abstract_or_text: Familial Alzheimer's disease (fAD) is an early-onset form of AD caused by autosomal-dominant variants in APP, PSEN1, or PSEN2, with PSEN1 accounting for most genetically defined cases [1]. The hippocampus is among the earliest and most severely affected brain regions in AD [2,3]. Human induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived brain organoids recapitulate key features of early human brain development and provide a tractable model for studying how fAD mutations perturb neurodevelopmental processes [4]. However, their interpretation is complicated by heterogeneous regional identity, variable maturation state, and cell-type composition across protocols [5,6]. Existing single-cell studies of human hippocampus cover prenatal [7] and postnatal [8-10] stages but do not provide a continuous developmental reference. By elevating the atlas approach in utilizing single-cell RNA-sequencing data, we obtain standardized information on the organoid cell class and type composition and maturation states. Here, we constructed the Human Developing Hippocampus Atlas (HuDeHA), an integrated single-cell reference comprising 658,059 cells spanning post-conceptional week 3 to 15.3 years, and used it to benchmark iPSC-derived brain organoids carrying PSEN1 E280A which is associated with fAD in a large Colombian population. Reference-based mapping revealed altered cellular composition in PSEN1 E280A organoids, including reduced radial glia and increased neural crest-derived neurons. These changes were accompanied by cross-lineage transcriptional alterations, including broad upregulation of the ventral patterning factor MEIS2 and reduced expression of the {beta}-binding protein transthyretin (TTR) in choroid-plexus and ependymal-associated populations. Reconstructed neuronal-lineage trajectories showed a shift toward mature states in PSEN1 E280A organoids. Together, these findings establish HuDeHA as a resource for developmental benchmarking of hippocampus-relevant organoid systems and describe cell-lineage-specific developmental changes in PSEN1 E280A organoids that may inform interpretation of early cellular alterations in fAD.
items.summary_zh: HuDeHA 汇集从受孕后第3周到15.3岁的658,059个细胞，为家族性阿尔茨海默病脑类器官提供发育参照。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 超大规模单细胞发育图谱与 PSEN1 E280A 类器官基准分析相结合，揭示了细胞组成、谱系转录状态和神经发育轨迹的改变。
items.abstract_zh: 家族性阿尔茨海默病（fAD）是一种早发型AD，由 APP、PSEN1 或 PSEN2 中的常染色体显性变异引起，其中 PSEN1 占遗传学定义病例的大多数[1]。海马是AD中最早且受累最严重的脑区之一[2,3]。人诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）衍生的脑类器官能够重现早期人脑发育的关键特征，并为研究 fAD 突变如何扰乱神经发育过程提供易于处理的模型[4]。然而，由于不同方案之间区域身份、成熟状态和细胞类型组成存在异质性，对这些类器官的解释较为复杂[5,6]。现有的人类海马单细胞研究覆盖产前阶段[7]和产后阶段[8-10]，但无法提供连续的发育参照。通过提升图谱方法对单细胞 RNA 测序数据的利用，我们获得了关于类器官细胞类别和细胞类型组成及其成熟状态的标准化信息。在此，我们构建了人类发育中海马图谱（Human Developing Hippocampus Atlas，HuDeHA），这是一个整合的单细胞参照图谱，涵盖从受孕后第3周到15.3岁的658,059个细胞；我们利用该图谱对携带 PSEN1 E280A 的 iPSC 衍生脑类器官进行了基准分析，该变异与一个大型哥伦比亚人群中的 fAD 相关。基于参照图谱的映射显示，PSEN1 E280A 类器官的细胞组成发生改变，包括放射状胶质细胞减少，以及神经嵴来源神经元增加。这些变化伴随跨谱系的转录改变，包括腹侧模式化因子 MEIS2 广泛上调，以及脉络丛和室管膜相关细胞群中 β-binding protein transthyretin（TTR）表达降低。重建的神经元谱系轨迹显示，PSEN1 E280A 类器官向更成熟状态偏移。综上，HuDeHA 建立了一个用于海马相关类器官发育基准分析的资源，并描述了 PSEN1 E280A 类器官中细胞谱系特异性的发育变化，这些结果可能有助于解释 fAD 早期的细胞改变。
items.author_line: Ivleva, E., Kruikov, E., Arboleda-Velasquez, J. F., Baranov, P.

items.title: Bivalent bispecific CD28 antibodies reinforce T-cell responsiveness and revert anergy/quiescence in patients treated with bispecific CD3 antibodies
items.abstract_or_text: Bispecific T-cell engagers stimulating CD3 (TCEs) rapidly gain momentum in oncological therapy. We report that single-agent TCE-treatment of cancer patients induces T cell hyporesponsiveness including abolished proliferative and lytic capacity. Single-cell RNA-sequencing identified transcriptional features of anergy/quiescence like upregulation of CBLB and BACH2, and suppression of AP 1-dependent activation programs due to isolated provision of T cell signal-1. To restore T cell functionality, we engineered bispecific costimulators (BiCos) which deliver signal-2 via highly efficient bivalent CD28-binding yet maintain strictly target-restricted activity after binding antigens expressed not only by tumor cells but also the extracellular matrix. Preclinical analyses documented that BiCos potentiate efficacy of single-agent TCE treatment with activity exceeding that of univalent Knob-into-Hole CD28-costimulators and revert T cell hyporesponsiveness. In humanized mice, BiCos induced elimination of established tumors in combination with very low doses of TCE. Finally, BiCos reversed molecular hallmark features of quiescence such as high expression of BACH2 and KLF2 in T cells of TCE-treated patients resulting in complete restoration of cellular function, thereby reinstating durable antitumor immunity.
items.summary_zh: 双价双特异性 CD28 抗体在双特异性 CD3 抗体治疗背景下恢复T细胞反应性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究结合患者T细胞单细胞转录组、BiCos工程化、TCE联合治疗和人源化小鼠实验，提示通过补充 signal-2 可能改善T细胞低反应状态；但仍属于 preprint 和前临床证据。
items.abstract_zh: 刺激 CD3 的双特异性T细胞接合剂（TCEs）正在肿瘤治疗中快速发展。我们报告，癌症患者接受单药 TCE 治疗后会出现T细胞低反应性，包括增殖能力和溶解能力消失。单细胞 RNA 测序识别出类似无反应/静息状态的转录特征，包括 CBLB 和 BACH2 上调，以及由单独提供T细胞 signal-1 引起的 AP-1 依赖性激活程序受抑。为恢复T细胞功能，我们设计了双特异性共刺激分子（BiCos），通过高效的双价 CD28 结合提供 signal-2；这些分子在结合不仅由肿瘤细胞表达、也由细胞外基质表达的抗原后，仍保持严格的靶标限制性活性。前临床分析显示，BiCos 可增强单药TCE治疗的疗效，其活性超过单价 Knob-into-Hole CD28 共刺激分子，并逆转T细胞低反应性。在人源化小鼠中，BiCos 与极低剂量的TCE联合使用可清除已形成的肿瘤。最后，BiCos 逆转了接受TCE治疗患者T细胞中静息状态的分子标志特征，例如 BACH2 和 KLF2 高表达，从而完全恢复细胞功能，并重新建立持久的抗肿瘤免疫。

items.title: Loss of TDP-43 function drives cryptic circular RNAs in neurodegenerative diseases
items.abstract_or_text: TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) is a key pathological hallmark of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and frontotemporal dementia (FTD) and a critical regulator of RNA splicing. While loss of TDP-43 induces aberrant splicing in linear transcripts, its impact on circular RNA (circRNA) biogenesis remains unexplored. Here, we show that TDP-43 depletion in human neurons induces widespread circRNA changes, especially upregulation of a distinct class of cryptic circRNAs that arise specifically upon loss of TDP-43. Some of these cryptic circRNAs incorporate cryptic exons derived from intronic sequences. Notably, these cryptic circRNAs exhibit greater stability than their corresponding linear RNA isoforms and accumulate progressively in neurons. Moreover, cryptic circRNAs are elevated in postmortem brain tissues from ALS, FTD and Alzheimer's disease (AD) patients. These findings reveal a previously unrecognized role for TDP-43 in repressing cryptic circRNA formation and establish these circRNAs as stable molecular signatures of TDP-43 dysfunction.
items.summary_zh: TDP-43 功能缺失与神经退行性疾病中的隐匿性环状RNA积累相关。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在人神经元和 ALS、FTD、AD 死后脑组织中观察到稳定的 cryptic circRNA 信号，为 TDP-43 功能障碍的分子表征提供了候选方向；由于是 preprint，机制和临床用途仍需进一步验证。
items.abstract_zh: TAR DNA-binding protein 43（TDP-43）是肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）和额颞叶痴呆（FTD）的关键病理标志，也是RNA剪接的重要调控因子。尽管 TDP-43 功能缺失会在线性转录本中诱导异常剪接，但其对环状RNA（circRNA）生成的影响仍未得到探索。在此，我们显示，在人神经元中耗竭 TDP-43 会诱导广泛的 circRNA 变化，尤其会增加一类仅在 TDP-43 功能缺失时产生的隐匿性 circRNA。其中一些隐匿性 circRNA 包含来源于内含子序列的隐匿性外显子。值得注意的是，这些隐匿性 circRNA 比其相应的线性RNA异构体更稳定，并在神经元中逐渐积累。此外，在 ALS、FTD 和阿尔茨海默病（AD）患者的死后脑组织中，隐匿性 circRNA 水平升高。这些发现揭示了 TDP-43 抑制隐匿性 circRNA 形成这一此前未被认识的作用，并确立了这些 circRNA 作为 TDP-43 功能障碍稳定分子标志的可能性。

items.title: Ultrasound-based deep learning-derived radiomics for preoperative prediction of sentinel lymph node metastasis in invasive breast cancer: a two-center retrospective study
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background Preoperative assessment of sentinel lymph node (SLN) metastasis may support individualized axillary management in patients with invasive breast cancer (IBC). We developed and externally validated a deep learning-derived ultrasound radiomics model for predicting SLN metastasis. Methods This retrospective two-center study included 246 patients with pathologically confirmed IBC. Center A provided 194 patients (93 with SLN metastasis), who were divided into training (n = 155) and internal test (n = 39) cohorts; 52 patients from Center B (20 with SLN metastasis) constituted an external validation cohort. Deep features were extracted from preoperative ultrasound images using a ResNet50 architecture. Feature selection was performed in the training cohort, and a gradient boosting decision tree classifier was developed. Discrimination was evaluated using receiver operating characteristic analysis; decision curve analysis was performed as an exploratory assessment of net benefit. Results Twenty-two deep learning-derived features were retained for model development. The model achieved areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.734 (95% CI, 0.655–0.813) in the training cohort, 0.761 (95% CI, 0.601–0.920) in the internal test cohort, and 0.742 (95% CI, 0.598–0.886) in the external validation cohort. In the external cohort, accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value, and negative predictive value were 0.769, 0.650, 0.844, 0.722, and 0.794, respectively. Decision curves are reported as exploratory analyses and do not establish clinical utility. Conclusion A deep learning-derived ultrasound radiomics model showed moderate and relatively consistent discrimination for SLN metastasis across the development and external validation cohorts. These findings support further evaluation of the model as an adjunctive preoperative risk-stratification tool; prospective validation in larger and more diverse populations is required before clinical implementation.
items.summary_zh: 双中心回顾性研究评估超声深度学习影像组学预测浸润性乳腺癌前哨淋巴结转移的能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 模型在内部测试和外部验证队列中表现相对稳定，但区分度中等，且决策曲线仅为探索性分析，尚不足以证明临床效用。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景：术前评估前哨淋巴结（SLN）转移可能有助于浸润性乳腺癌（IBC）患者接受个体化腋窝管理。我们开发并外部验证了一个用于预测SLN转移的深度学习衍生超声影像组学模型。方法：这项双中心回顾性研究纳入246名经病理学确诊的IBC患者。中心A提供194名患者（其中93名存在SLN转移），并将其分为训练队列（n = 155）和内部测试队列（n = 39）；中心B的52名患者（其中20名存在SLN转移）构成外部验证队列。使用 ResNet50 架构从术前超声图像中提取深度特征。在训练队列中进行特征选择，并构建梯度提升决策树分类器。通过受试者工作特征曲线分析评估区分能力；决策曲线分析用于探索性评估净获益。结果：保留22个深度学习衍生特征用于模型开发。模型在训练队列、内部测试队列和外部验证队列中的受试者工作特征曲线下面积分别为0.734（95% CI，0.655–0.813）、0.761（95% CI，0.601–0.920）和0.742（95% CI，0.598–0.886）。在外部队列中，准确率、敏感度、特异度、阳性预测值和阴性预测值分别为0.769、0.650、0.844、0.722和0.794。决策曲线作为探索性分析报告，不能证明临床效用。结论：深度学习衍生超声影像组学模型在开发队列和外部验证队列中对SLN转移表现出中等且相对一致的区分能力。这些结果支持进一步评估该模型作为术前风险分层辅助工具；在临床实施前，仍需在更大且更多样化的人群中开展前瞻性验证。

items.title: The role of hsa-miR-21-5p, hsa-miR-210-3p, hsa-miR-197-3p, hsa-miR-125a-5p and hsa-miR-206-3p as circulating microRNA signatures in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a neurodegenerative disorder distinguished by selective loss of motor neurons. Up to now, robust biomarkers for diagnosis and disease progression are missing. This study aims to examine the expression of hsa-miR-21-5p, hsa-miR-210-3p, hsa-miR-197-3p, hsa-miR-125a-5p and hsa-miR-206-3p, as candidate ALS biomarkers in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) and serum. Methods CSF and serum samples were collected from 50 ALS patients, 50 age- and sex-matched healthy controls and 50 disease-controls. The expression of the selected miRNAs was quantified by quantitative reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (qRT-PCR). Associations with clinical parameters, including disease phenotype, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis functional rating scale - revised (ALSFRS-R) at diagnosis, disease duration and progression rate, were evaluated. Functional enrichment analysis was performed on predicted miRNA target genes using Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) with Reactome, Gene Ontology Biological Process and Hallmark gene sets. Results Hsa-miR-210-3p, hsa-miR-206-3p, and hsa-miR-21-5p were upregulated in ALS CSF and serum, whereas hsa-miR-125a-5p was downregulated. Hsa-miR-206-3p and hsa-miR-210-3p correlated with disease duration and progression rate, while hsa-miR-21-5p correlated negatively with ALSFRS-R. No statistically significant results were found for hsa-miR-197-3p, between ALS phenotype and miRNA levels and between miRNA expression in CSF and serum. Functional enrichment analyses revealed biological signals related to cellular stress responses, TP53 signaling, SLIT/ROBO axonal guidance, innate immunity-like programs and tissue remodeling. Conclusions Serum and CSF hsa-miR-210-3p, hsa-miR-206-3p and hsa-miR-21-5p could serve as ALS biomarkers. The functional footprint of the dysregulated miRNAs suggest a stress-driven concept of ALS, involving axonal degeneration, immune activation and neuromuscular remodeling.
items.summary_zh: 研究在 ALS 患者、健康对照和疾病对照中评估5种循环 microRNA 的CSF与血清表达。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 150名受试者的 qRT-PCR 分析将候选 microRNA 与 ALSFRS-R、病程和进展速率联系起来，但相关性结果不等于因果或已确立的临床诊断效用。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景：肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种以运动神经元选择性丧失为特征的神经退行性疾病。迄今仍缺乏稳健的诊断和疾病进展生物标志物。本研究旨在评估 hsa-miR-21-5p、hsa-miR-210-3p、hsa-miR-197-3p、hsa-miR-125a-5p 和 hsa-miR-206-3p 作为ALS候选生物标志物时，在脑脊液（CSF）和血清中的表达情况。方法：研究收集了50名ALS患者、50名年龄和性别匹配的健康对照者以及50名疾病对照者的CSF和血清样本。采用定量逆转录聚合酶链式反应（qRT-PCR）对所选 miRNA 的表达进行定量。研究评估了其与临床参数之间的关联，包括疾病表型、诊断时的肌萎缩侧索硬化功能评定量表—修订版（ALSFRS-R）、病程和进展速率。研究还使用 Gene Set Enrichment Analysis（GSEA）结合 Reactome、Gene Ontology Biological Process 和 Hallmark gene sets，对预测的 miRNA 靶基因进行了功能富集分析。结果：在ALS患者的CSF和血清中，Hsa-miR-210-3p、hsa-miR-206-3p 和 hsa-miR-21-5p 上调，而 hsa-miR-125a-5p 下调。hsa-miR-206-3p 和 hsa-miR-210-3p 与病程和进展速率相关，而 hsa-miR-21-5p 与 ALSFRS-R 呈负相关。对于 hsa-miR-197-3p、ALS表型与 miRNA 水平之间的关系，以及CSF和血清中的 miRNA 表达之间的关系，均未发现具有统计学意义的结果。功能富集分析揭示了与细胞应激反应、TP53 signaling、SLIT/ROBO 轴突导向、先天免疫样程序和组织重塑相关的生物学信号。结论：血清和CSF中的 hsa-miR-210-3p、hsa-miR-206-3p 和 hsa-miR-21-5p 可能作为ALS生物标志物。失调 miRNA 的功能印记提示一种应激驱动的ALS概念，涉及轴突变性、免疫激活和神经肌肉重塑。
